svg.aria-label: homelab-infra: a private cloud on bare-metal Proxmox. Terraform builds VMs from a cloud-init template, k3s spans the machines over Tailscale with a GPU worker node, and Atlantis runs Terraform from pull requests. The drawing follows one change: pull request, CI checks, Atlantis plan, atlantis apply, Proxmox VM clone, k3s.
